name: Confidence Greedy (low_confidence remask)
tagline: Each step, unmask the top-k positions by max-probability confidence using LLaDA's uniform num_transfer_tokens schedule; greedy argmax tokens.
pseudocode:
1. For each block $b$, compute per-step quota $k_t = \mathrm{num\_transfer\_tokens}(M_b, S)$
2. logits $= \mathrm{model}(x)$;  $p = \mathrm{softmax}(\mathrm{logits})$;  $x_0 = \arg\max_v p$
3. confidence $c_i = p_{i, x_{0,i}}$ over masked positions only
4. Pick top-$k_t$ positions by $c_i$; commit $x_{0,i}$ at those positions
5. Repeat until block fully unmasked
diff_from_baseline: LLaDA default 'low_confidence' remasking (Nie et al., LLaDA, arXiv:2502.09992). Standard confidence-greedy reference for masked diffusion LMs.

name: KLASS (KL-stable confidence)
tagline: Unmask positions whose top-1 distribution is both stable across the recent KL history and confident; falls back to top-k confidence otherwise.
pseudocode:
1. Track running KL between current and previous step distributions per position
2. logits $= \mathrm{model}(x)$;  $p = \mathrm{softmax}$;  $x_0 = \arg\max p$;  conf $= p_{x_0}$
3. $\mathrm{stable}_i = \mathbb{1}[\max\text{ of last }H\text{ KLs} < \tau_{KL}]$
4. ready $=$ stable $\wedge$ (conf $> \tau_c$) $\wedge$ masked
5. If any ready: commit those; else fall back to top-$k_t$ by confidence
6. Update KL history; commit greedy tokens at chosen positions
diff_from_baseline: Kim et al., NeurIPS 2025 (KLASS, arXiv:2511.05664). State-of-the-art demask strategy combining KL-based stability with confidence to early-commit positions.

name: Top-K Margin (Dream)
tagline: Unmask the top-k positions by the margin between top-1 and top-2 token probabilities; no KL stability check.
pseudocode:
1. For each block, compute per-step quota $k_t$
2. logits $= \mathrm{model}(x)$;  $p = \mathrm{softmax}$;  $x_0 = \arg\max p$
3. Sort $p$ descending: margin $m_i = p_{(1),i} - p_{(2),i}$
4. Restrict to masked positions; pick top-$k_t$ positions by $m_i$
5. Commit greedy tokens $x_0$ at those positions
diff_from_baseline: Ye et al., 'Dream 7B: Diffusion Large Language Models' (arXiv:2508.15487). The 'topk_margin' algorithm from Dream's decoding suite; corresponds to the 'prophet' heuristic (margin) without KLASS's stability term.

name: KLASS (cmd alias)
tagline: Same KL-stable + confidence demasking as the KLASS edit baseline, run as a cmd-style entry alias.
pseudocode:
1. Maintain KL history of length $H$ between consecutive per-position distributions
2. Each step: stable $= \max_H \mathrm{KL} < \tau_{KL}$; ready = stable $\wedge$ conf $> \tau_c$
3. If ready set non-empty, commit those positions only
4. Otherwise commit top-$k_t$ positions ranked by confidence
5. Greedy tokens at chosen positions; update KL history
diff_from_baseline: Kim et al., NeurIPS 2025 (arXiv:2511.05664). Reference KLASS strategy (cmd-style alias for the same algorithm as the 'KLASS' edit baseline).

name: Prophet (top-k margin)
tagline: Top-k margin position selection — the 'prophet' / Dream-style heuristic that picks positions by top1 minus top2 probability.
pseudocode:
1. Compute logits $\to p = \mathrm{softmax}$ at every step
2. margin $m_i = p_{(1),i} - p_{(2),i}$ over masked positions
3. Pick top-$k_t$ positions by margin
4. Commit greedy argmax tokens there
diff_from_baseline: Dream 7B (Ye et al., arXiv:2508.15487), 'topk_margin' option. Often called 'prophet' in masked-diffusion literature for its lookahead-style margin scoring.

name: Random demask
tagline: Uniform random position selection with a linear quota schedule and argmax token assignment — the template default.
pseudocode:
1. For each step compute remaining masked $n$ and required new picks $k = \lceil n / (S - t) \rceil$
2. Sample $k$ masked positions uniformly at random
3. Commit $\arg\max p$ tokens at those positions
4. Continue until all positions are unmasked
diff_from_baseline: Trivial random-position baseline shipped as the LLaDA template default. Lower-bound reference with no informed scoring.
